applicability: CORE or Marketplace Portal accounts with the corresponding optional product records, service profile 4.1.0. Existing base product rules apply alongside these additional terms.
content:
A note without a credit_redemptions record is already governed by its usual eligibility and remaining-face fields. No redemption election is required. Conditional notes retain their eligibility sets after becoming usable; early redemption does not widen them.

Detailed local effects and operation names: `RST-redemption`.

provenance.source: Primary-author synthetic extension of the frozen 4.0.2 business mechanisms; no claim of a verbatim source SOP rule.
